instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: recognise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: That is not a language that I ((recognise)).
I find it difficult to ((recognise)) words in songs.

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: emphasise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: She spoke loudly during her speech to ((emphasise)) what she was saying.
From a young age, it is important to ((emphasise)) the importance of reading.

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: sympathise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I don’t understand his situation, so I cannot ((sympathise)) with him.
I can ((sympathise)) with you because I also have food poisoning.

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: empathise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I believe it is important to have the ability to ((empathise)) with others.
When creating an interesting character, it is important to give them some flaws so that people can ((empathise)) with them.

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: mesmerise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: Don’t look at the spinning wheel it will ((mesmerise)) you.
It is rumoured that vampires have the power to ((mesmerise)) their victims.

instruction.text: Find the word ___ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: minimise. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I feel like he tried to ((minimise)) my feelings, when he told me to suck it up and stop crying.
You can buy sunglasses with a coating to ((minimise)) the glare from the sun.
